ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: {SUBJECT}
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A colonist passionate about a skill wants a proper space for it: a workshop, kitchen, laboratory, hospital, greenhouse or barn.

plain.li: If I had {SUBJECT}, I could do the best work of my life. Right now I'm making do.
I keep working in a corner, between the food and somebody's laundry. We need {SUBJECT}.
Give me {SUBJECT} and I'll show you what I can really do.

warm.li: I love this work so much. With {SUBJECT}, I could do it properly, for all of us.
I've been sketching plans for {SUBJECT} at night. Could we make it real?

blunt.li: You want good work from me? Then give me {SUBJECT}, not a patch of dirt.
No more working in the hallway. I want {SUBJECT}.

cheerful.li: Okay, hear me out. We build {SUBJECT}. Mine. Well, ours. But mostly mine. It'll be great!
I've got so many ideas! All I need is {SUBJECT} to try them.

gloomy.li: I used to be good at this, before. Maybe with {SUBJECT} I could be again.
Working like this is slowly killing what I love about it. Maybe {SUBJECT} would help.

cold.li: My skills are being wasted. With {SUBJECT}, my output would rise considerably.

plain.li: This is it. This is where I'll do something great.
A proper space to work. My hands are itching already.

warm.li: Thank you. I'll make every one of you proud.

blunt.li: Finally. Now stay out of my way and watch.

cheerful.li: I love it! I love it! I'm never leaving!

gloomy.li: I don't know what to say. It's... it's actually good.

cold.li: Productivity will now increase. You chose well.

plain.li: I'll keep working in my corner, then.

blunt.li: Don't come complaining when the work is mediocre.

gloomy.li: Nobody here cares about doing things well.

warm.li: That's alright. I'll make it work for now.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: to do some {SUBJECT}
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A colonist passionate about a kind of work that's switched off for them wants to be allowed to do it.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: {SUBJECT} is enabled for {FOR_nameDef} in the Work tab.

plain.li: I'd really like to do some {SUBJECT}. It's what I'm good at, and nobody's letting me.
Could you put me on {SUBJECT}? I miss it.

warm.li: I'd love to help with {SUBJECT}. I think I could make a real difference there.

blunt.li: Why am I not doing {SUBJECT}? I'm better at it than anyone here.

cheerful.li: Pick me for {SUBJECT}! Pick me! I promise I'm good at it!

gloomy.li: I used to love {SUBJECT}. Now I just watch other people do it.

cold.li: Assigning me to {SUBJECT} is the obvious, efficient choice.

plain.li: Thank you. This is what I'm meant to be doing.

cheerful.li: Yes! Back to what I love!

plain.li: I'll keep doing whatever I'm told, then.

gloomy.li: Guess my skills don't matter here.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: art where people gather
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: Artists, and anyone with taste, want sculptures in the dining room or rec room.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: A new piece of art stands in a dining room or rec room.

plain.li: Our dining room is so bare. A sculpture or two would make every meal better.
We survive just fine. I'd like us to live a little, too. Some art in the common rooms?

warm.li: Beauty matters, even out here. Maybe especially out here. Could we put some art where everyone can see it?

blunt.li: These walls are depressing. Somebody sculpt something.

cheerful.li: I've got the perfect idea for a sculpture! It's a squirrel. A really heroic squirrel.

gloomy.li: We eat surrounded by blank walls. It feels like a waiting room for death.

cold.li: Art in shared spaces improves morale. It is a sensible investment.

plain.li: Look at that. We're not just surviving anymore.

cheerful.li: I keep staring at it during dinner. Is that weird? I don't care.

gloomy.li: It's beautiful. I'd forgotten things could be beautiful.

plain.li: Blank walls it is.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a decent {SUBJECT}
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A colonist who lives to fight wants a weapon worth carrying, or a brawler stuck holding a gun wants something to swing.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: {FOR_nameDef} wields a {SUBJECT} of at least normal quality.

plain.li: When the raiders come, I want something better than this in my hands. A decent {SUBJECT}, please.
This weapon is going to get me killed. Could someone make or find me a proper {SUBJECT}?

warm.li: I'd protect everyone better with a good {SUBJECT}. That's all I want it for.

blunt.li: Get me a real {SUBJECT}. I'm tired of fighting with junk.
I don't do my best work with a stick and a prayer.

cheerful.li: A shiny new {SUBJECT}? For me? Well, not yet, but I'm hoping!

gloomy.li: Next raid, this thing will fail me and I'll die. Unless someone gets me a better {SUBJECT}.

cold.li: Equip me properly and the raiders die faster. It's simple arithmetic.

plain.li: Now that's a weapon. Let them come.

blunt.li: Finally. Raiders, form an orderly line.

cheerful.li: Look at the balance on this! I'm going to name it.

plain.li: Guess I'll fight with what I have. Again.

gloomy.li: Remember this when I'm lying in the dirt.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a brewery
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A colonist with a chemical interest really, really wants the colony to brew its own beer.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony has {THING}, or at least five beers in stock.

plain.li: Hops, a barrel, some patience. That's all it takes. Could we brew our own beer?
A colony isn't a colony without beer. I'd happily build {THING} myself.

warm.li: Imagine sharing a cold beer with everyone after a long day. It's good for the spirit.

blunt.li: I need a drink. We all need a drink. Build {THING}.

cheerful.li: Two words: colony brewery. Okay, that's two words and a dream.

gloomy.li: I've been dry for weeks. The days are getting very long.

cold.li: Beer improves morale and trade value. Brewing is rational.

plain.li: The brew is on! Best news all season.

cheerful.li: A toast! To whoever built this! Also to me, for asking!

gloomy.li: Things just got a little more bearable.

plain.li: No brewery. Water it is. Ugh.

blunt.li: Fine. I'll find my own fun. You won't like it.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: {SUBJECT}
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: Gourmands, and anyone sick of raw food, want better meals.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony stocks at least {TARGET} {SUBJECT}, or {FOR_nameDef} gets to eat one.

plain.li: I ate raw corn for lunch. Just raw corn. Could we have {SUBJECT}, please?
A proper meal now and then would do wonders for everyone. Could we have {SUBJECT}?

warm.li: Good food brings people together. Could our cooks make {SUBJECT} sometimes?

blunt.li: The food here is an insult to my tongue. I want {SUBJECT}.

cheerful.li: I've been dreaming about {SUBJECT}. Like, literally dreaming. Last night there was gravy.

gloomy.li: Every meal tastes the same. Like survival. Like nothing.

cold.li: Better meals improve mood at minimal cost. Have the cooks make {SUBJECT}.

plain.li: Now THAT is a meal. Compliments to the cook.

cheerful.li: I want to marry this meal.

blunt.li: See? Was that so hard? Delicious.

gloomy.li: For one meal, I forgot where we are.

plain.li: Raw food again. My stomach has filed a complaint.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a freezer for the food
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A cook, or someone who just ate something rotten, wants cold storage so food stops spoiling.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: There's a stockpile in a room kept below 0°C.

plain.li: Half the harvest is turning to mush. We need a freezer, with {THING} keeping it cold.
I can't cook with ingredients that are already rotting. A freezer, please.

warm.li: All that hard work in the fields, wasted. A freezer would save so much.

blunt.li: I just ate something green that wasn't supposed to be green. Build a freezer.

cheerful.li: Picture it: a cold room full of food that doesn't smell! Revolutionary!

gloomy.li: Watching food rot is like watching the days we have left go bad.

cold.li: Food spoilage is waste. A freezer eliminates it.

plain.li: Cold storage! Nothing goes to waste now.

cheerful.li: I walked in and my breath fogged up. I love it.

plain.li: Guess we'll keep eating fast and hoping.
